021import com.ghostchu.quickshop.api.QuickShopAPI;
022import com.ghostchu.simplereloadlib.ReloadResult;
023import com.ghostchu.simplereloadlib.ReloadStatus;
024import com.ghostchu.simplereloadlib.Reloadable;
025import dev.dejvokep.boostedyaml.YamlDocument;
026import dev.dejvokep.boostedyaml.settings.Settings;
027import org.jetbrains.annotations.NotNull;
028import org.jetbrains.annotations.Nullable;
029
030import java.io.File;
031import java.io.IOException;
032import java.io.InputStream;
033import java.net.URL;
034import java.net.URLConnection;
035import java.util.ArrayList;
036import java.util.Collections;
037import java.util.List;
038
039/**
040 * QSConfig
041 *
042 * @author creatorfromhell
043 * @since 6.2.0.11
044 */
045public class QSConfig implements Reloadable {
046
047  protected final String fileName;
048  protected final File file;
049  protected final String defaults;
050  protected final List<String> nodes = new ArrayList<>();
051  protected YamlDocument yaml;
052  protected Settings[] settings;
053
054  public QSConfig(final String fileName, final String defaults, final List<String> nodes, final Settings... settings) {
055
056    this.defaults = defaults;
057    this.fileName = fileName;
058    this.nodes.addAll(nodes);
059    file = new File(QuickShopAPI.getPluginInstance().getDataFolder(), fileName);
060
061    this.settings = settings;
062
063    if(!file.exists()) {
064      QuickShopAPI.getPluginInstance().getLogger().warning("Configuration file doesn't exist, creating new one. File Name:" + fileName);
065    }
066  }
067
068  public boolean load() {
069
070    try(final InputStream in = getResource(defaults)) {
071
072      if(in != null) {
073        this.yaml = YamlDocument.create(file, in, settings);
074
075        return true;
076      }
077    } catch(final IOException ignore) {
078
079      QuickShopAPI.getPluginInstance().getLogger().warning("Error while creating config \"" + file.getName() + "\".");
080      return false;
081    }
082    return false;
083  }
084
085  public YamlDocument getYaml() {
086
087    return yaml;
088  }
089
090  public void setYaml(final YamlDocument yaml) {
091
092    this.yaml = yaml;
093  }
094
095  public boolean save() {
096
097    try {
098
099      yaml.save(file);
100      return true;
101    } catch(final IOException ignore) {
102
103      QuickShopAPI.getPluginInstance().getLogger().warning("Error while saving config \"" + nodes.get(0) + "\".");
104      return false;
105    }
106  }
107
108  public void setComment(final String route, final List<String> comments) {
109
110    if(yaml.contains(route)) {
111      yaml.getBlock(route).setComments(comments);
112    }
113  }
114
115  public void setComment(final String route, final String comment) {
116
117    setComment(route, Collections.singletonList(comment));
118  }
119
120  public @Nullable InputStream getResource(@NotNull final String filename) {
121
122    try {
123      final URL url = this.getClass().getClassLoader().getResource(filename);
124      if(url == null) {
125        return null;
126      } else {
127
128        final URLConnection connection = url.openConnection();
129        connection.setUseCaches(false);
130
131        return connection.getInputStream();
132      }
133    } catch(final IOException ignore) {
134      return null;
135    }
136  }
137
138  @Override
139  public ReloadResult reloadModule() throws Exception {
140
141    load();
142
143    QuickShopAPI.getPluginInstance().getLogger().info("Configuration reloaded successfully. File Name:" + fileName);
144
145    return ReloadResult.builder().status(ReloadStatus.SUCCESS).build();
146  }
147}
